movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms mimic the wing-spreading movements of the great argus.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers stand in a circle or move in a procession.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Body swings to the left and right, particularly in warrior variants.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Dancers jump while standing in a circle.
movement_profile.posture: Graceful and upright, often mimicking bird-like stances.

signature_moves.description: Hand gestures mimicking the wing movements of the great argus.
signature_moves.name: Bungai Ajat

signature_moves.description: Lifting a heavy wooden rice mortar with the teeth.
signature_moves.name: Ngajat Lesong

music_profile.sound_description: The music is driven by the interplay of large and medium gongs (tawak and bebendai) providing a deep, resonant foundation, punctuated by the rhythmic beat of drums (ketebung/dumba) and the melodic, high-pitched ringing of the engkromong small gongs.

basic_steps: Observe the bird-like movements of the common hill myna and great argus.
Practice the 'Bungai Ajat' hand gestures mimicking wing movements.
Incorporate rhythmic leg movements while maintaining a graceful posture.
For male dancers, practice the rhythmic swinging of the body while holding a shield and sword.
teaching.formation: Dancers often stand in a circle or lead a procession.
